subject.title: fix(scripts): add curl --connect-timeout to install scripts

question: Should this reliability fix move to the canonical openclaw.ai installer sources, and should curl use the existing 20-second wget threshold or an explicitly approved 10-second threshold?
rationale: The current PR changes a compatibility-sensitive public setup default in non-owning copies, while repository policy and deployed paths point to a separate canonical repository; the intended cross-repository synchronization and timeout policy require owner confirmation.

options.title: Fix canonical installers first
options.body: Update openclaw.ai/public/install.sh and install-cli.sh, synchronize any retained copies and tests, and explicitly validate the selected timeout against normal and stalled connections.

options.title: Limit this PR to repo-local use
options.body: Merge only after removing the public-installer claim and documenting why these copies intentionally differ from the hosted artifacts.

options.title: Pause and resubmit
options.body: Close this branch in favor of a focused change in openclaw/openclaw.ai if these scripts are not intended to remain independently maintained.

recommendation.title: Fix canonical installers first
recommendation.body: Update openclaw.ai/public/install.sh and install-cli.sh, synchronize any retained copies and tests, and explicitly validate the selected timeout against normal and stalled connections.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is connected to current installer history and is the strongest available routing candidate for deciding the canonical website-repository boundary.
